purpose: Sampling throughput engineering measurement for the continuous training actors; no model-strength claim
machine: Ryzen 7 7800X3D (8 cores / 16 threads), 32 GB, AMD RX 7800 XT, Windows 11, Node 24.19.0, onnxruntime-node 1.31.1 (DirectML execution provider bundled)
conditions: All measurements ran while the gpu-main training run was active on the same machine (8 standard actors plus the GPU learner), so CPU and GPU were shared; numbers are not isolated hardware limits

selfPlay.note: share of main-thread time, Node --cpu-prof, 6 matches

directmlMicrobenchmark.graph: ai/policy.onnx rewritten to per-row state input

steadyStateThroughput.protocol: 4 actor processes on slots 36-39 of a scratch run (actorSeedOffset 45,000,000, data discarded), 90 s warm-up, completed learner decisions counted over the next 210 s

limitations: Single machine, single short window per configuration, shared with a running training job; no confidence interval
DirectML results differ from CPU inference by up to a few 1e-6, so a fast actor is equivalent in rules and policy but not bit-identical in sampled actions
Not yet used in any training run; throughput gains do not by themselves imply stronger models
